cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader after Moses, has brought the people into Canaan, and Jericho and Ai have both fallen (Joshua 1:1-2; 6; 8). Now news of all this reaches every king west of the Jordan, from the hill country and the foothills all along the coast of the Great Sea. Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, and every one of their kings heard it.

cards.question: All those kings west of the Jordan hear the news. What do they do?

answers.text: Come together to wage war on Israel
Pack up and leave the land for good
Build new walls around all their cities

cards.text: But one group isn't lining up for battle. The people of Gibeon heard what Joshua did to Jericho and Ai, and they've got a different idea.

cards.question: The people of Gibeon don't grab their swords. Instead, they acted ___ and set out as envoys.

cards.text: They load their donkeys with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended, then put on patched sandals and threadbare clothes. Friend, they look like they spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and believe me, I KNOW that look.

cards.question: The Gibeonites bring food along for the trip. True or false: their supply of bread is fresh and soft.

cards.text: They walk right into Israel's camp at Gilgal and tell Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a distant land; please make a treaty with us.”

cards.question: The Gibeonites are Hivites, and they want a treaty with Israel. How do the men of Israel answer them at first?

answers.text: They wonder if the Hivites live nearby
They agree to a treaty right away
They tell the Hivites to go home

cards.text: “We are your servants,” they say to Joshua. So Joshua asks it straight: “Who are you and where have you come from?”

cards.question: The Gibeonites tell Joshua they've come from a very distant land. Why do they say they came?

answers.text: Because of the fame of the LORD
Because a famine drove them out
Because enemies chased them from home

cards.question: The Gibeonites list the reports they've heard about the LORD. True or false: they mention what happened at Jericho and Ai.

cards.text: Instead it's Egypt, and the two Amorite kings beyond the Jordan: Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan. Jericho and Ai? … Not. One. Word.
They say their elders sent them to ask for a treaty. Then they hold up their bread and say it was warm the day they packed it, and now look at it: dry and moldy.

cards.question: The Gibeonites say their wineskins cracked and their clothes and sandals wore out from their very long ___.

cards.text: So the men of Israel sample the provisions. And friend, as a baker, I RESPECT a taste test.

cards.question: The men of Israel check out the Gibeonites' moldy bread for themselves. What do they NOT do?

answers.text: Seek the counsel of the LORD

cards.question: With no word from the LORD, what does Joshua do with the Gibeonites?

answers.text: Makes a treaty of peace to let them live
Sends spies out to check their story
Sends them away with nothing at all

cards.question: Joshua makes the treaty with the Gibeonites. True or false: the leaders of the congregation swear an oath to them too.

cards.text: Three days after the treaty, the Israelites learn something about these travelers from a distant land.

cards.question: True or false: three days after the treaty, Israel learns the Gibeonites really do live in a very distant land.

cards.text: They're neighbors, living right among Israel, and on the third day Israel reaches their cities: Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim. Friend, they faked a whole long trip with moldy bread just to fool the NEIGHBORS.

cards.question: Israel arrives at the Gibeonites' cities. True or false: Israel attacks them.
Why doesn't Israel attack the Gibeonites' cities?

answers.text: The leaders swore an oath to them by the LORD
The Gibeonite armies were far too strong
The Gibeonites paid Israel to leave them alone

cards.text: And the whole congregation grumbles against the leaders. Friend, I shared a drawer with dead batteries who argued all day long, and even they never grumbled like a WHOLE congregation.

cards.question: The leaders say they cannot touch the Gibeonites. They'll let them live, so that no ___ will fall on them because of the oath.
The leaders will let the Gibeonites live. But what will the Gibeonites do for the whole congregation?

cards.text: So the leaders keep their promise. Then Joshua summons the Gibeonites: “Why did you deceive us by telling us you live far away from us, when in fact you live among us?”

cards.question: Joshua tells the Gibeonites who deceived him that now they are under a ___.

cards.text: Joshua says they'll serve as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of his God, for good. Then the Gibeonites answer: they were told the LORD commanded Moses to give Israel all the land and wipe out all its inhabitants.

cards.question: The Gibeonites heard what the LORD commanded Moses. Why do they say they did all this?

answers.text: They greatly feared for their lives
They wanted to spy on Israel
They hoped to take Israel's land

cards.text: Then they say, “Now we are in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you.” Friend, that might be the most honest line they've said this whole time.

cards.question: The Gibeonites put themselves in Joshua's hands. What does Joshua do with them?

answers.text: Delivers them so Israel doesn't kill them
Drives them out of the land for good
Hands them over to the angry congregation

cards.question: True or false: Joshua makes the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD too.

cards.text: They serve that way to this day, at the altar in the place the LORD would choose. And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story's not done.

findings.problem: The closing line that says the story isn't over nearly copies the doc's example word for word: "And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story's not done." The example reads "And that's where we'll leave it for now. Trust me, friend, this story's not done." It needs Papa Dorin's own line for this passage.

rule.text: The examples show the idea. Write your own line each time.
